apps.name: SideStore
apps.subtitle: Open-source on-device signing and app management.
apps.localizedDescription: SideStore is a community-maintained open-source signing and app-management project. Check the project's release notes and setup requirements before using an IPA.

versions.localizedDescription: Release notes address sign-in HTTP 503 responses. This is an alpha release; review its upstream notes before installing.

apps.name: UTM SE
apps.subtitle: Open-source virtual machines for iOS.
apps.localizedDescription: UTM SE is the no-JIT edition of UTM for running virtual machines on iOS. Virtual machine images and operating-system licences are separate from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Includes new snapshots and improved iOS touch controls. See the official UTM release notes for the complete changelog.

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.subtitle: Open-source PSP emulator.
apps.localizedDescription: PPSSPP is a cross-platform PSP emulator. Use game files that you own and follow the project's legal and compatibility guidance.

versions.localizedDescription: Official iOS release. The upstream project links the full changelog and other platform downloads.

apps.name: iSH
apps.subtitle: A small Linux shell environment for iOS.
apps.localizedDescription: iSH is an open-source shell environment using a user-mode x86 emulator. Its latest published GitHub IPA build shown here is dated May 2023; check upstream for newer instructions.

versions.localizedDescription: Upstream release note: fixes diagnostics in the Files provider.
